scope: low-energy sprain or minor strain with preserved sensation and some ability to move the area
response: For a possible sprain or strain, protect and rest the area. Use a cold pack wrapped in cloth for 15 to 20 minutes at a time during the first 1 to 2 days, and raise the limb when comfortable. Gentle support can help if it is not tight or numb. Ease back to normal use as pain settles.
red_flags: cannot put any weight on the limb or use it at all
pain is worsening rather than improving
a snap or pop was felt at the time of injury
high-energy trauma such as a fall from height
